prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Derive one transparent battle-map token from this exact GM-approved KITCHIN portrait. Keep its flexible black segmented centipede-like trunk, compact dark head, mandibles, TWO antennae and narrow curved tail stinger. It has exactly TWELVE WALKING LEGS, SIX PAIRED SETS: six legs on the left and six on the right, paired attachment points along the trunk. Antennae, mandibles and tail do not count as walking legs.
TRUE OVERHEAD camera, about 85–90 degrees above the ground; see the dorsal plate surfaces, not a low side/front portrait. Body aligned north-south in a shallow natural curve, HEAD and antennae toward BOTTOM / SOUTH, rear/stinger toward TOP / NORTH. Separate all six paired sets of jointed legs clearly against transparent space; no hidden extra pairs, six-legged insect body, big scorpion claws or added wings. Preserve the approved black chitin, restrained brown edge highlights and plated anatomy. Use broad painterly values and slightly stout readable leg segments so the silhouette works at small token size. All legs, both antenna tips and stinger safely inside the square frame. Genuine transparent alpha, no rock, soil, scenery, floor, base, border, text, checkerboard or long cast shadow.
